# Sentinel Final Handoff Report — Task 8ca1b27c

The open graph-theory conjecture `Candidate: (nontrivial) ⇒ 2 ≤ sub_total_domination_number` has been **settled as PROVEN** with a fully verified Lean 4 kernel proof.

## Victory Audit Status
- **Verdict**: VICTORY CONFIRMED
- **Independent Auditor**: teamwork_preview_victory_auditor (`25015490-aefb-4559-b161-3f6a20fac1bb`)
- **Phase A (Timeline)**: PASS
- **Phase B (Integrity Forensics)**: PASS (Preamble unchanged; no cheating or macros; only allowed axioms)
- **Phase C (Independent Test Execution)**: PASS (`check.sh Challenge_8ca1b27c.lean` exited 0; axioms: `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`)

## Mathematical Rationale
For any simple graph $G$ on $n \ge 2$ vertices, the degree of every vertex is strictly bounded by $n - 1 < n$.
Thus:
- For $t = 0$: $\text{largestDegreeSum}(G, 0) = 0 < n$.
- For $t = 1$: $\text{largestDegreeSum}(G, 1) = \max_v \deg(v) < n$.
Consequently, no parameter $t < 2$ satisfies $n \le \text{largestDegreeSum}(G, t)$.
Therefore, the search over candidates up to $n$ in `minUpTo n (fun t => n ≤ largestDegreeSum G t)` yields either a witness $t \ge 2$ or the fallback $n \ge 2$. In either case, $\text{subTotalDominationNumber}(G) \ge 2$.

## Deliverables
- Verified Lean solution: `/mnt/home/japake298/project/GraphConjecturing/handoff/promising13/task_8ca1b27c/Challenge_8ca1b27c.lean`
- Verification report: `/mnt/home/japake298/project/GraphConjecturing/handoff/promising13/task_8ca1b27c/REPORT.md`
- Sentinel handoff: `/mnt/home/japake298/project/GraphConjecturing/handoff/promising13/task_8ca1b27c/.agents/sentinel_1/handoff.md`
- Victory audit report: `/mnt/home/japake298/project/GraphConjecturing/handoff/promising13/task_8ca1b27c/.agents/teamwork_preview_victory_auditor_1/handoff.md`

All crons have been cancelled and subagents terminated. Project is complete.
